```yaml
name: Build Snapshot

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      snapshot_name:
        description: 'Name of the built snapshot'
        value: ${{ jobs.build-snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}

jobs:
  build-snapshot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      snapshot_name: ${{ steps.build.outputs.snapshot_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          clean: true

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build snapshot
        id: build
        env:
          SANDBOX_ITERATE_REPO_REF: ${{ github.sha }}
          DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME: iterate-sandbox-${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Replace the following command with the actual snapshot build command
          # The script should use the environment variable DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME
          # and handle idempotent creation of the snapshot.
          npx daytona snapshot build --name "$DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME"
          echo "snapshot_name=$DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
```
